1.title: Layout Review & Requirements Gathering
1.description: I start by receiving your finalized design layout (Figma, Sketch, PSD, etc.). I thoroughly review all pages, element states, responsive versions, and technical specifications. I'll ask clarifying questions to ensure a complete understanding of the project goals and to anticipate any challenges before development begins.

quote.text: Nikolai quickly understood our design and asked several important questions about interactive elements, which helped avoid misunderstandings later.

2.title: Responsive Frontend Development
2.description: This is where the design comes to life. I write clean, semantic HTML and meticulously craft styles (SCSS/Tailwind) to precisely match the approved layout across all devices. Necessary interactivity and animations are implemented using modern JavaScript (ES6+).

3.title: CMS Integration (WordPress, etc.)
3.description: If your project needs a Content Management System (primarily WordPress), I seamlessly integrate the frontend code into a custom theme. I configure necessary post types, custom fields (using ACF), and page templates to ensure managing your content is straightforward and efficient.

quote.text: The WordPress integration was excellent! The admin panel turned out intuitive, and our managers easily add content.

4.title: Quality Assurance & Optimization
4.description: Rigorous testing is crucial. I conduct thorough checks across various devices and browsers to ensure full functionality. This includes testing forms, interactive elements, optimizing load speed (Core Web Vitals), and resolving any identified bugs.

5.title: Site Deployment & Client Handover
5.description: The final step involves deploying the completed website to your hosting environment. This includes configuring the domain and installing the SSL certificate. I provide all necessary access credentials and clear instructions for site management, especially if a CMS is involved.

quote.text: The site was launched exactly on schedule. Nikolai helped with the migration to our hosting and explained everything clearly. We are satisfied with the work!
